source.verification: Recorded interpretation. Original private evidence is unavailable to other consumers; this summary is not independent verification.

text: The Bug 2061214 implementation and verification reports say Create Save stays unavailable until the required title and date helpers register. Those controls belong to linked bugs; this patch supplies validation and conversion hooks. When integrating those controls, preserve the missing-helper guard so an incomplete draft cannot start a transaction. This is reported behavior for the reviewed commit 15a5b7c23c0aa132c4e78e4d7c336c09d9c215af, not a general rule for all calendar dialogs. The later verification did not complete matching runtime tests.
title: Create Save requires registered field helpers
